newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares climb, gains seen limited.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares climb, gains seen limited.

text.p: Austrian shares ended higher on selective demand on Wednesday and traders predicted the index would remain in a range between 1,280 and 1,300 to 1,310 points in the short term.
Regional electricity firm EVN, oil and chemicals group OMV and Vienna airport operator Flughafen Wien accounted for most of the volume.
Traders said foreign investors remained at bay, no one wanting to make the first move.
"The foreign clients always ring up and ask why no one is buying in Vienna," said one dealer.
Another said that an increase in demand could push the market up instantly but it could equally crumble for lack of buying interest.
The blue chip ATX index climbed 12.22 points or 0.95 percent to 1,295.91. Among its constituents 18 gainers outweighed three decliners.
The session's top gainer was microchip maker AMS, which ended up 3.86 percent at 971.10 schillings.
The leading loser was insurer Wiener Staedtische, falling 2.27 percent to 1,035 schillings.
The July ATX futures rose 12.10 points to 1,298.0.
